name: summa-reserves-coverage-private
title: Summa Reserves Coverage (Private Reserves)
description: Two-step check for an exchange or custodian that publishes a single-currency Summa-style Merkle-sum liability tree. Step 1 recomputes the hash and sum chains from one published leaf to the root and confirms the root's total (art-620). Step 2 takes that root total as the outstanding figure and returns only whether the committed reserve amounts, in the GENIUS Act reserve categories, add up to at least it; the amounts stay private (reserves predicate). Run by the reserve holder. A customer checks their own leaf against the same root with art-620. It does not show the liabilities list is complete.

steps.handoff: Recomputes the hash chain and the sum chain from one published leaf to the root and confirms the root hash and root total. Stage 1 of 2. Step 2 then checks the committed reserves against that root total, in the same minor unit, as the outstanding figure.

Returns one bit, whether the committed reserve amounts cover the outstanding figure, together with the as-of date; the reserve amounts stay private. Final stage. Anchor the finished composite afterwards with the anchor recipe; the anchor is not a step.
